tvShow.name: Vigil
tvShow.overview: The mysterious disappearance of a Scottish fishing trawler and a death on-board the submarine HMS Vigil bring the police into conflict with the Navy and British security services. DCI Amy Silva and DS Kirsten Longacre lead an investigation on land and at sea into a conspiracy that goes to the very heart of Britain’s national security.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When a crew member is found dead aboard the Trident nuclear submarine HMS Vigil, Detective Amy Silva is flown out to investigate.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With Vigil in danger, Amy must fight to continue her investigation. Meanwhile, Kirsten’s enquiries lead to tragedy.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Kirsten’s investigation takes her into the heart of Scottish politics, but when she unearths a navy cover-up, it leaves Amy questioning who she can trust on Vigil.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Kirsten closes in on the killer, but their capture reveals the grave threat that Vigil faces. On the submarine, Amy makes a terrifying discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Vigil is forced into lockdown as disaster strikes. With communication lost, Kirsten desperately hunts for clues to the source of the threat to Vigil.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Amy is trapped and running out of time, but will assistance arrive too late? On land, Kirsten chases down the traitor’s accomplice. When the traitor on Vigil puts their plans into action, the crew are forced to fight for their lives.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: When a sailor is found dead on submarine HMS Vigil, DCI Silva uncovers a conspiracy.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When a weapons test turns deadly, with allies from the Middle East among the dead, all eyes are on DCI Amy Silva, who tries to ignore the politics to get to the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After Amy and Kirsten battle for their lives against an armed killer, Amy follows a new lead to the Middle East. She discovers someone on the airbase was complicit in the attack.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When an officer is stabbed on base, Eliza warns Amy to get control of her investigation. Meanwhile, Kirsten uncovers key evidence linking a squadron member to the attack.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Amy and Eliza are held hostage by the dissidents at the heart of the investigation, who demand their help to infiltrate the base. Kirsten will do anything to find Amy.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of a brutal rescue mission, Amy is questioning everything. Kirsten begs her to come home, but Amy can’t let go of her suspicions.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Amy finally discovers the full scale of the conspiracy, and she must decide if she is prepared to risk everything to find those responsible.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: A weapons test turns deadly, with allies from the Middle East among the dead.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: DCI Silva and DI Longacre investigate the murder of a British citizen in the Arctic, but they soon find themselves caught in an escalating political situation.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Amy is on the clock to save a hostage, while Kirsten navigates international agendas in the Arctic in the hunt for a missing Chinese scientist.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Amy needs to help Kirsten after the death of someone on the hub. She is faced with a ticking clock to clear Kirsten’s name before she is made into a scapegoat.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Henrik and Kirsten close in on the missing Jia, with Amy not far behind. But as tensions rise and new allegiances are formed, the danger of the Arctic wilderness becomes apparent.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The truth of Jia’s discovery forces Amy and Kirsten to reassess the situation on Svalbard and embark on a rescue mission that has them facing a new, unexpected danger.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Amy finds herself on the wrong side of the law, and Kirsten puts herself in danger to keep Amy safe and get to the truth – leading to the hardest choice of their careers.

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: Military investigator DCI Silva fights to uncover conspiracies of silence.

reviews.author: Peter McGinn
reviews.content:
I tried this show mainly because I have liked Suranne Jones in just about everything she has been in since she exploded onto Coronation Street many years ago. That is a tribute to her not just as an actress, but also as someone who seems to always choose good projects.

The relationship between her character and DS Longacre, shown almost entirely in flashback memories, comes across now and then as cliched, but not enough to put me off. I like how they use it to allow Longacre to get information to Suranne’s character using a sort of memory code to get past those who are monitoring their messages.

I couldn’t help but notice that on a certain website I won’t name, even though this show received the excellent rating it deserves, there were a lot of 1 star ratings in the reviews. Some of them due to the diversity of the cast. Even though most of us have been more than ready to let go of the 50 years of role domination by white, straight men (of which I should note I am all three), there is that low percentage of haters who can’t let go, however reasonable they try to sound in their one- or two-sentence rants.

There were also complaints that the extreme sabotage problems that come up would never all happen to a single submarine. But this is fiction and if they want to go the explosive cliffhanger route instead of using a slow burning plot, I am okay with it. One person even said that details were all wrong for the military branch. Sorry, but my liking a show doesn’t depend on them wearing the right hats for their ranks.

Anyway, it was entertaining, which is what I look for in, ah, entertainment.
